newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: FORECAST - Dutch company results due Jan 3.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Dutch company results due Jan 3.

text.p: There are no major Dutch company results scheduled for the remainder of this week.
For the week starting January 6 we are collecting result forecasts for Oce van der Grinten (due Friday, January 10).
For the following week (beginning January 13), we are looking for forecasts for Randstad and Ahrend year results and OPG's half-year figures.
Banks and brokers interested in contributing to Reuters surveys can contact the Amsterdam newsroom on +31-20-504-5000 or fax their forecasts to +31-20-504 5040.
